title: The Apex Manual of the Matched Ward
summary: An apex manual of the azure sky that matches ward to ward and ends in a mantle thrown over every ally in the field.

title: The Azure Sky Warden's Course
summary: A course for wardens of the azure sky who stand over one ward and learn to still a blow with a single word of qi.

title: A Treatise of the Twin Hawks' Shelter
summary: A treatise on the shelter of two hawks that cover a brood with their wings and turn every attack to the open sky.

title: The Basin and River Apex Ward
summary: An apex course that teaches the ward to gather like a basin and to run off a blow like a river in spate.

title: The Paired Sovereign Shield Manual
summary: A long manual of the paired tradition that carries the shield from a single plate to a sovereign ward held over a whole company.

title: The Azure Wing Canon
summary: A canon of the wing that spreads the ward like a pinion and folds it away again with no seam left behind.

title: The Wind-Sworn Warden's Canon
summary: A canon of the wind-sworn that binds the warden's ward to the oath and lets the gale carry blows away from the sworn.

title: A Bearing Held Against the Storm
summary: A manual of the held bearing that teaches the warden to take one line and keep it against any weight of attack.

title: The Oath of the Open Company
summary: A short manual for a sworn company with no fixed rim to its ward and one oath that holds every member inside it.

title: The Plateau Bearing Manual
summary: A manual of the plateau that teaches the wind-sworn to stand in the open with a ward that needs no wall.

title: The Sworn Gale Apex Course
summary: An apex course that gathers the wards of the sworn into one gale which breaks over the attacker and clears the ground.

title: The Last Oath of Warding
summary: A closing manual of the wind-sworn in which the warden swears the final oath and holds it against any end.
